definitions.explanation: The eggs of fish, used as a general term covering all varieties including salmon roe, cod roe, herring roe, and others.

examples.japanese: {魚卵|ぎょらん}は{塩分|えんぶん}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Fish roe is high in salt content.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{魚卵|ぎょらん}を{使|つか}った{料理|りょうり}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In Japan, there are many dishes that use fish roe.

examples.japanese: {魚卵|ぎょらん}アレルギーがあるので、いくらも{明太子|めんたいこ}も{食|た}べられない。
examples.english: I have a fish roe allergy, so I can't eat salmon roe or mentaiko.

notes:
USAGE:
{魚卵|ぎょらん} is a general term encompassing all types of fish eggs. Individual types have their own names: いくら (salmon roe), たらこ (cod roe), {数の子|かずのこ} (herring roe), {明太子|めんたいこ} (spicy cod roe), とびこ (flying fish roe).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魚卵|ぎょらん}アレルギー (fish roe allergy)
- {魚卵|ぎょらん}{加工品|かこうひん} (processed fish roe products)
- {生|なま}{魚卵|ぎょらん} (raw fish roe)
